beats.text: Built your app with AI? It's probably leaking something.
One command. Nine security agents. No API key, no account.
Like a database table anyone can read, or a live Stripe key sitting in your repo.
It doesn't stop at finding them. It plans every fix, in the right order.
Then writes one prompt for Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex.
Apply the safe fixes, and verify the hole is really closed.
Or keep it watching while you build.
whitehat-squad. Find, fix, verify. Free, and it runs offline.
